summary: Full backend + frontend verification of Konphlux steampunk mobile app. All 12 pytest cases passed against the external EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL: districts (22 sorted, slug lookup, 6 nearby excluding self+home, 404 unknown), feed (shape + create post persists + like toggle increments/decrements + 404 unknown), bazaar (8 listings + sorted categories + item lookup + 404), profile (4 menu groups). Frontend Playwright test (mobile viewport 375x667) verified: Feed loads with 7 posts (6 seeded + 1 created), stories row + composer + trending visible, like button toggles heart icon + count, compose modal creates post that appears back in feed, Districts tab shows all 22 cards in 2-col grid, tapping district opens detail with hero/features/Chatmonger, tapping a nearby district navigates to it, Bazaar shows listings with category chip filter (chip-Instruments narrows list, chip-All restores), product detail shows image/price/seller/description and Add to cart flips to 'Added to cart', HQ tab shows Konphlux ID card + treasury balance + all 4 menu groups (You/Signals/Controls/Assistance), Lamplight (dark) mode toggle switches theme (id-card bg becomes dark rgb(53,48,42)), bottom tab nav switches between Feed/Districts/Bazaar/HQ. No red screens, no page errors. Only console warnings are non-blocking RN Web deprecations ('shadow*' style, props.pointerEvents) coming from third-party libs.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend correctly excludes MongoDB _id in every read query using projection {'_id': 0}; POST /feed also pops _id before return — good.
Frontend uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from env (no hardcoded URLs).

All interactive elements have testID (post-*, like-*, story-*, open-composer, compose-*, district-*, nearby-*, chip-*, listing-*, product-back, add-to-cart, konphlux-id-card, balance-card, theme-toggle, menu-*).
No deprecated Expo packages (no expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch); uses expo-image, expo-linear-gradient, expo-haptics, expo-router, expo-font — all current.

Non-blocking: react-native-web emits 'shadow* style props are deprecated' warnings from Bazaar ProductCard shadow* styles. Purely a web-preview warning; RN mobile still uses shadow* on iOS. Can migrate to boxShadow later but not required.
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds districts/feed/bazaar on startup. Test created 2 TEST_-prefixed posts via POST /api/feed (harmless, persist in feed as latest dispatches).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All backend endpoints + all listed frontend flows pass. Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_konphlux_api.py — reuse and extend for regressions. External base URL sourced from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. No auth in the app.
